recoveryPolicyReadFailed.zh-CN: 无法读取企业恢复策略
recoveryPolicyReadFailed.en: Unable to read the enterprise recovery policy

resumeNoPermission.zh-CN: 当前账号无权恢复配置会话
resumeNoPermission.en: The current account is not allowed to restore the configuration session

resumeRestoreFailed.zh-CN: 无法恢复返回的配置会话
resumeRestoreFailed.en: Unable to restore the returned configuration session

recoveryRestoredWithConflicts.zh-CN: 已恢复页面中断前的 {remaining} 项本地变更；其中 {conflicts} 项与权威草稿冲突，需先完成 Base / Mine / Latest 裁决。
recoveryRestoredWithConflicts.en: Restored {remaining} local change(s) kept from before the page interruption; {conflicts} of them conflict with the authoritative draft and require Base / Mine / Latest adjudication first.

recoveryPartiallyCommitted.zh-CN: 页面中断后已由权威草稿确认 {committed} 项保存成功，并恢复 {remaining} 项未落服变更；请复核后重试。
recoveryPartiallyCommitted.en: After the interruption the authoritative draft confirmed {committed} saved change(s) and restored {remaining} change(s) not yet persisted to the server; review and retry.

recoveryRestoredPendingReview.zh-CN: 已恢复页面中断前的 {remaining} 项本地变更，并确认尚未写入权威草稿；请复核后重试。
recoveryRestoredPendingReview.en: Restored {remaining} local change(s) kept from before the page interruption and confirmed they are not in the authoritative draft yet; review and retry.

recoveryAllCommitted.zh-CN: 页面中断前的 {committed} 项变更已由权威草稿确认保存成功，未重复写入。
recoveryAllCommitted.en: {committed} change(s) from before the page interruption were confirmed saved by the authoritative draft without duplicate writes.

recoveryDraftUnreadable.zh-CN: 权威草稿暂不可读；本地恢复数据仍保留，请联网后重新对账
recoveryDraftUnreadable.en: The authoritative draft is temporarily unreadable; local recovery data is preserved. Reconnect and reconcile again

discardRecoveryConfirm.zh-CN: 确定放弃此页面中断前保留的本地未保存变更吗？此操作无法撤销。
discardRecoveryConfirm.en: Discard the local unsaved changes kept from before this page interruption? This action cannot be undone.

exitWithoutRecoveryConfirm.zh-CN: 浏览器无法保留恢复副本，退出会丢失当前未保存变更。仍要退出吗？
exitWithoutRecoveryConfirm.en: The browser cannot keep a recovery copy; exiting will lose the current unsaved changes. Exit anyway?

handoffFailed.zh-CN: 无法移交到应用设计中心
handoffFailed.en: Unable to hand off to the application design center

manifestMissing.zh-CN: 未找到 {blockType} 的能力清单，无法保存该变更
manifestMissing.en: No capability manifest found for {blockType}; this change cannot be saved

saveInterruptedWithConflictsCommitted.zh-CN: 网络响应中断；已确认 {committed} 项保存成功，剩余变更需要冲突裁决。
saveInterruptedWithConflictsCommitted.en: The network response was interrupted; {committed} change(s) confirmed saved and the remaining changes need conflict adjudication.

saveInterruptedWithConflicts.zh-CN: 网络响应中断；权威草稿包含并发变更，剩余变更需要冲突裁决。
saveInterruptedWithConflicts.en: The network response was interrupted; the authoritative draft contains concurrent changes and the remaining changes need conflict adjudication.

saveCompletedAfterInterrupt.zh-CN: 保存已在服务端完成；响应虽中断，当前页面已按权威草稿恢复，未重复写入。
saveCompletedAfterInterrupt.en: Saving already completed on the server; although the response was interrupted, this page was restored from the authoritative draft without duplicate writes.

saveResumingAfterInterrupt.zh-CN: 响应中断后已确认 {committed} 项保存成功；正在从最新修订继续保存剩余 {remaining} 项。
saveResumingAfterInterrupt.en: After the interrupted response, {committed} change(s) were confirmed saved; saving the remaining {remaining} change(s) continues from the latest revision.

saveReconciledPartial.zh-CN: 保存已在服务端完成：响应中断的 {reconciled} 项已由权威草稿确认，其余 {others} 项已从最新修订继续保存，未重复写入。
saveReconciledPartial.en: Saving completed on the server: the {reconciled} change(s) from the interrupted response were confirmed by the authoritative draft, and the remaining {others} were saved continuing from the latest revision without duplicate writes.

saveReconciledAll.zh-CN: 保存已在服务端完成：网络响应中断后已确认 {count} 项成功；当前页面已按最新修订恢复，未重复写入。
saveReconciledAll.en: Saving completed on the server: {count} change(s) were confirmed after the network interruption; this page was restored to the latest revision without duplicate writes.

saveReconciledRemaining.zh-CN: 已确认 {count} 项在服务端保存成功；{remaining} 项仍保留在本地。
saveReconciledRemaining.en: {count} change(s) confirmed saved on the server; {remaining} change(s) remain stored locally.

saveFailedKeepLocalGeneric.zh-CN: 保存失败；本地未保存变更已保留
saveFailedKeepLocalGeneric.en: Save failed; local unsaved changes are preserved

refreshDraftFailed.en: Unable to refresh the configuration draft

governanceResumeFailed.zh-CN: 无法恢复 ChangeSet 编辑

leaseTakeoverCompleted.zh-CN: 接管已在服务端完成，当前页面已恢复编辑；本地内容未被覆盖。
leaseTakeoverCompleted.en: The takeover completed on the server and this page is editable again; local content was not overwritten.

leaseTakeoverLost.zh-CN: 编辑权刚被另一会话取得，已刷新为只读；当前页面未被覆盖。
leaseTakeoverLost.en: Edit authority was just taken by another session and the view refreshed to read-only; this page was not overwritten.

localRecoveryFoundTitle.zh-CN: 发现页面中断前保留的本地变更
localRecoveryFoundTitle.en: Local changes kept from before the page interruption were found

localRecoveryFoundBody.zh-CN: 先读取权威草稿并对账，再决定继续保存；恢复过程不会自动重放写请求。
localRecoveryFoundBody.en: The authoritative draft is read and reconciled first before deciding to continue saving; recovery never replays write requests automatically.

localRecoveryMultipleCandidates.zh-CN: 本设备发现 {count} 个独立会话候选；当前只处理最新一项，绝不自动合并或覆盖其他会话。
localRecoveryMultipleCandidates.en: {count} independent session candidates were found on this device; only the newest one is handled now, and other sessions are never merged or overwritten automatically.

recoveryPolicyPendingNotice.zh-CN: {message}；在策略可确认前不会保存任何恢复副本，也不会进入配置模式。
recoveryPolicyPendingNotice.en: {message}; no recovery copy is saved and configuration mode stays closed until the policy can be confirmed.

newPageExplainTitle.zh-CN: 在应用设计中心创建页面
newPageExplainTitle.en: Create a page in the application design center

newPageExplainReason.zh-CN: 新页面会改变页面树、路由和发布资源，不属于当前页面的局部展示调整。
newPageExplainReason.en: A new page changes the page tree, routes and published resources; it is not a local adjustment of the current page.

writeBlockedNotice.zh-CN: 已拦截真实业务写入；交互预览只保留本地状态。
writeBlockedNotice.en: Real business writes were intercepted; interaction preview keeps state locally only.

permissionRevokedNotice.zh-CN: 配置权限已收回，当前会话已即时转为只读。浏览器中的未保存差异仍会保留，但不会保存、提交或移交；可退出配置模式，或在权限恢复后继续。
permissionRevokedNotice.en: Configuration permission was revoked and this session immediately became read-only. Unsaved differences in the browser are preserved but will not be saved, submitted or handed off; exit configuration mode or continue after permission is restored.

conflictMustAdjudicateTitle.zh-CN: 并发变更必须在应用设计中心裁决
conflictMustAdjudicateTitle.en: Concurrent changes must be adjudicated in the application design center

conflictDetail.zh-CN: Base r{baseRevision} / Latest r{latestRevision}；已保留 {pendingCount} 项 Mine。原地配置不会刷新后直接覆盖 Latest。
conflictDetail.en: Base r{baseRevision} / Latest r{latestRevision}; {pendingCount} Mine change(s) kept. In-place configuration never overwrites Latest by refreshing directly.

isolatedChangeSetSubtitle.zh-CN: 安全编辑写入隔离 ChangeSet；不会写入业务数据
isolatedChangeSetSubtitle.en: Safe edits write into an isolated ChangeSet; business data is never written

capabilityListNotice.zh-CN: 下列能力来自服务端可信清单；就地修改先保存在浏览器，点击“保存”后仅写入隔离 ChangeSet。
capabilityListNotice.en: The capabilities below come from a server-trusted manifest; in-place edits are staged in the browser first, and only an isolated ChangeSet is written after clicking “Save”.

noInlineCapabilityNotice.zh-CN: 此对象未声明现场配置能力，默认进入应用设计中心。
noInlineCapabilityNotice.en: This object declares no in-place configuration capability and goes to the application design center by default.

jsonFormatHint.zh-CN: JSON 格式；无效输入不会进入待保存变更。
jsonFormatHint.en: JSON format; invalid input never enters the pending changes.

refreshBaselineKeepLocal.zh-CN: 刷新基线并保留本地变更
refreshBaselineKeepLocal.en: Refresh baseline and keep local changes

readOnlyLeaseHeldElsewhere.zh-CN: 编辑权由其他会话持有
readOnlyLeaseHeldElsewhere.en: Edit authority held by another session

pendingDiffSubtitle.zh-CN: 仅展示当前浏览器尚未写入 ChangeSet 的变更。
pendingDiffSubtitle.en: Only changes this browser has not written into the ChangeSet yet.

carriedContentValue.zh-CN: 当前 ChangeSet、选择对象、返回位置
carriedContentValue.en: current ChangeSet, selected object and return location

safetyMethodValue.zh-CN: 10 分钟、本人/本租户/本环境绑定、一次性 contextId
safetyMethodValue.en: 10 minutes, bound to the actor/tenant/environment, one-time contextId

urlPrivacyNote.zh-CN: URL 不包含 pagePid、recordPid 或业务筛选；应用设计中心会重新检查权限。
urlPrivacyNote.en: The URL contains no pagePid, recordPid or business filters; the application design center re-checks permissions.

continueToStudio.en: Continue to the application design center

handoffPropertyReason.zh-CN: 属性 {propertyPath} 涉及 {effectTags}，需要依赖分析和专业发布治理。
handoffPropertyReason.en: Property {propertyPath} involves {effectTags} and requires dependency analysis and specialist release governance.

handoffPageReason.zh-CN: 页面级结构、路由和资源关系需要在应用设计中心统一治理。
handoffPageReason.en: Page-level structure, routes and resource relationships need unified governance in the application design center.

handoffNoInlineReason.zh-CN: 此对象未声明可安全就地写入的属性，系统不会猜测影响范围。
handoffNoInlineReason.en: This object declares no property that is safe to write in place; the system never guesses the impact scope.

authorityLeaseTransferred.zh-CN: 编辑权已转移到其他会话
authorityLeaseTransferred.en: edit authority moved to another session

authorityChangedPartial.zh-CN: 响应中断后已确认 {committed} 项保存成功；{authority}，剩余 {remaining} 项保留在本地且未重放。
authorityChangedPartial.en: After the interrupted response, {committed} change(s) were confirmed saved; {authority}, and the remaining {remaining} change(s) stay local without replay.

authorityChangedCompleted.zh-CN: 保存已在服务端完成；{authority}，当前页面已按权威草稿恢复为只读。
authorityChangedCompleted.en: Saving completed on the server; {authority}, and this page was restored to read-only from the authoritative draft.

authorityChangedIncomplete.zh-CN: 保存未完成；{authority}，本地未保存变更已保留且未重放。
authorityChangedIncomplete.en: Saving did not complete; {authority}, and local unsaved changes are preserved without replay.

permissionRevokedPartial.zh-CN: 配置权限已收回；已确认 {saved} 项保存成功，剩余 {remaining} 项保留在本地且未重放。
permissionRevokedPartial.en: Configuration permission was revoked; {saved} change(s) confirmed saved and the remaining {remaining} change(s) stay local without replay.

permissionRevokedCompleted.zh-CN: 保存已在服务端完成；配置权限已收回，当前页面已按权威草稿恢复为只读。
permissionRevokedCompleted.en: Saving completed on the server; configuration permission was revoked and this page was restored to read-only from the authoritative draft.

permissionRevokedIncomplete.zh-CN: 保存未完成；配置权限已收回，本地未保存变更已保留且未重放。权限恢复后可继续对账，或先退出配置模式。
permissionRevokedIncomplete.en: Saving did not complete; configuration permission was revoked and local unsaved changes are preserved without replay. Reconcile after permission is restored, or exit configuration mode first.
